title: When is early stopping beneficial under label noise? A phase diagram for kernel gradient flow
abstract: arXiv:2610.33846v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Early stopping is commonly used to prevent fitting label noise from degrading generalization. Does this mean that, when a positive fraction of the training labels is intrinsically unpredictable, the best test error must occur before interpolation? Experiments on a CIFAR10 classification task with randomly labeled examples motivate the opposite possibility: although fixed-feature and shallow models exhibit late-time deterioration of the test error, the need for early stopping essentially disappears in larger, deeper convolutional networks even after the random labels have all been classified correctly. We determine when late-time deterioration disappears entirely in a solvable setting. translated_title: 标签噪声下早停止何时有益？核梯度流的相图
translated_abstract: 早停止（early stopping）通常被用来防止对标签噪声的拟合损害泛化性能。这是否意味着，当训练标签中有一定比例本质上不可预测时，最佳测试误差必然出现在插值之前？在带有随机标签样本的CIFAR10分类任务上的实验激发了相反的可能性：尽管固定特征模型和浅层模型表现出测试误差在训练后期的恶化，但在更大、更深的卷积网络中，即使随机标签已全部被正确分类，对早停止的需求也基本消失了。我们在一个可求解的设定中确定了后期恶化完全消失的条件。对于合成噪声分类任务上的核梯度流，我们推导出精确的高维学习曲线，并得到了一个相图，该相图由学习输入与输出之间共享关系的线性核分量与其他分量之间的平衡所控制……
tldr: 该论文通过在可解的核梯度流设定中推导高维学习曲线并构建相图，精确刻画了标签噪声下测试误差“后期恶化”现象消失的条件，从而解释了为什么深度网络即使完全记住噪声标签也无需早停止。
en_tdlr: By deriving sharp high-dimensional learning curves and a phase diagram for kernel gradient flow, this paper pinpoints exactly when late-time test-error deterioration under label noise vanishes, explaining why deep networks trained to full interpolation may not require early stopping.
